module.name: docs-book
module.summary: Long-form narrative exposition of the TriadicFrameworks canon.
module.purpose: Provides the structured, reader-oriented Book that explains the canon, architecture, and conceptual journey.
module.audience: Readers, contributors, educators, and newcomers to TriadicFrameworks.

index.md.purpose: Front door for the TriadicFrameworks Book; provides orientation and reading paths.

canon.md.purpose: Defines the five commitments of the TriadicFrameworks canon.

part-i.md.purpose: Introduces the conceptual landscape and motivations behind TriadicFrameworks.

part-ii.md.purpose: Explains the core architecture, operators, and structural grammar.

part-iii.md.purpose: Shows how the framework is applied, extended, and mastered.

sessions.md.purpose: Explains session grammar, usage patterns, and adaptation guidelines.

registry.md.purpose: Narrative explanation of the module registry and how readers interpret module categories.

glossary.md.purpose: Definitions of key terms used throughout the Book.
